title: Be Healthy and Confident
subtitle: 考点：健康生活 / physical health / be able to
passage: Tina used to be shy. She was afraid to speak in class, and she did not enjoy sports. Last year, she decided to change herself. She joined the school running club and started to eat more healthily.

At first, running was hard. She could only run for five minutes. But she did not give up. She ran three times a week, and after two months she was able to run for half an hour. Her body became stronger and she felt more energetic. She also found that exercise helped her sleep better.

Slowly, Tina became more confident. She put up her hand in class and gave a short speech in front of everyone. “When I take care of my body, I feel good about myself,” she says. Now she tells her friends, “Good health and confidence go hand in hand. Make a plan, take small steps, and never stop.”
vocab: confident 自信的 · healthily 健康地 · energetic 精力充沛的 · physical 身体的 · speech 演讲 · give up 放弃 · able 能够的
